title: System status
errorHint: Can’t reach the Campbooks API right now. Check that the server is running, then reload.

admin.title: System
admin.lead: How this instance is running. Nothing here shows a password, key or anyone’s mail.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load the system overview
loadError.lead: The server didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.

ai.title: AI
ai.lead: Each role is a kind of work. A role with no model set up is simply not used.

where.externalAllowed: outside this instance’s network, allowed to receive mail
where.externalRefused: outside this instance’s network, so mail is not sent to it

check.pendingDetail: its answers are used once it gets obvious test emails right
check.failedDetail: got only {{right}} of {{total}} obvious test answers right, so its answers are not used and the rules sort mail alone
check.unavailableDetail: its answers are not used until it does

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.lead: The background work this instance runs, and the jobs that gave up. A job’s contents are never shown here: only what ran, how often, and why it stopped.

loadError.title: Couldn’t load the job queue
loadError.lead: The server didn’t answer. Try again in a moment.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyLead: No job is waiting, running or failed right now.

retryAll.question_one: Retry the {{count}} failed {{kind}} job? It starts again from its first attempt.
retryAll.question_other: Retry all {{count}} failed {{kind}} jobs? Each starts again from its first attempt.
retryAll.done_one: {{count}} {{kind}} job is back in the queue.
retryAll.done_other: {{count}} {{kind}} jobs are back in the queue.
retryAll.more: There are more: retry again to requeue the rest.
retryAll.none: No failed {{kind}} jobs were left to retry.
retryAll.error: Couldn’t retry the {{kind}} jobs. Try again.

failed.title: Failed jobs
failed.emptyLead: Every job either finished or is still being tried.
failed.retried: The job is back in the queue.
failed.unchanged: That job was no longer failed, so nothing changed.
failed.superseded: Another job of this kind is already waiting, so this one was left as it was.
failed.retryError: Couldn’t retry the job. Try again.
failed.discardError: Couldn’t discard the job. Try again.
failed.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it.
failed.discardQuestion: Discard this {{kind}} job? It is deleted for good.
